request: Build a turn-based RPG battle game in a single HTML file. The hero fights random enemies that scale with level (goblin, skeleton, orc, dark knight), turn-based actions are Attack, Fireball that costs MP, Potion heal, and Flee with a success roll, the enemy counterattacks after a delay, defeating enemies grants gold and XP with a level-up system that raises HP MP attack and defense, enemy death screens and hero defeat states are handled, and saving progress to localStorage with a new-game reset.

intent.goal: build a turn-based rpg battle game in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Dungeon Duel HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
